name: staggered-entrance-group
title: Staggered Entrance Group
description: A staggered entrance group animates children in with tightly offset start times (≤60ms) so the eye reads one coherent arrival instead of a simultaneous pop, each item settling on a spring. Reduced motion renders everything immediately visible with no movement — choreography is presentation, never gating.
